**P2 — Poll until all evidence used below is available**

This poll may return immediately from the cached victim `WRAPPER_RETURN`, while peer return records or the structured platform-timeout record are still delayed in CloudWatch. The subsequent assertions can therefore fail a correct run with “No SDK wrapper return” or missing timeout evidence. Extend readiness to include every peer return and the accepted timeout/cancellation evidence, with a delayed-log unit test.
